name: CRM Quote Request — Before Insert — Set Requester
CRM Quote Request — Before Validate — Auto Promote Status
script:
old_doc = doc.get_doc_before_save()
old_status = old_doc.status if old_doc else None

# Auto-promote: Estimation attached the file in Pending or Revision Requested
# state — flip to Quote Received. Covers both first-round upload AND every
# revision-round re-upload. Without the Revision Requested case, round 2 would
# never advance and Script 5's downstream task/notification work wouldn't fire.
#
# MUST run in Before Validate (not Before Save) so the subsequent validate()
# phase evaluates mandatory_depends_on against the NEW status — otherwise
# quote_value / quote_margin would not be enforced and the save would commit
# with NULLs.
if (
    old_doc is not None
    and old_status in ("Pending", "Revision Requested")
    and doc.status == old_status
    and doc.quote_file
):
    doc.status = "Quote Received"

# Positive-value guard: mandatory_depends_on cannot catch Currency/Percent
# default 0.0, so explicitly reject zero/negative quote_value or quote_margin
# whenever the QR is no longer Pending. Idempotent for Quote Received -> Accepted /
# Revision Requested moves because the values are already populated at that point.
if doc.status != "Pending":
    if not doc.quote_value or doc.quote_value <= 0:
        frappe.throw(_("Quote Value must be greater than 0."), title=_("Quote Value Required"))
    if not doc.quote_margin or doc.quote_margin <= 0:
        frappe.throw(_("Quote Margin must be greater than 0."), title=_("Quote Margin Required"))

name: CRM Lead — Before Save — Stage Transition
CRM Lead — After Save — Stage Side Effects
script:
old_doc = doc.get_doc_before_save()
old_status = old_doc.status if old_doc else None
old_lead_status = old_doc.lead_status if old_doc else None
new_status = doc.status
new_lead_status = doc.lead_status

if old_doc is None and new_status == "C0":
    frappe.get_doc({
        "doctype": "CRM Task",
        "task_type": "call_lead",
        "title": f"Call Lead — {doc.lead_name or doc.name}",
        "status": "Todo",
        "priority": "Medium",
        "reference_doctype": "CRM Lead",
        "reference_docname": doc.name,
        "description": f"New lead {doc.lead_name or doc.name} has arrived at C0. Make the initial call and log the disposition.",
    }).insert(ignore_permissions=True)

# Direct creation at C1 (referral / lead spotting per PRD §4.1) — enroll in Brevo
# here since the status_changed path below won't fire when old_status is None.
if old_doc is None and new_status == "C1" and doc.email:
    frappe.enqueue(
        "crm.integrations.brevo.api.enroll_in_sequence",
        email=doc.email,
        lead_name=doc.name,
    )

status_changed = bool(old_status) and old_status != new_status
lead_status_changed = bool(old_lead_status) and old_lead_status != new_lead_status

# Retry log cancellation: lead exits the retry-active set (C0 + Active/Cold-Unresponsive/Reactivated),
# or is explicitly Archived.
was_retry_active = old_status == "C0" and old_lead_status in ("Active", "Cold-Unresponsive", "Reactivated")
is_retry_active = new_status == "C0" and new_lead_status in ("Active", "Cold-Unresponsive", "Reactivated")
if (status_changed or lead_status_changed) and was_retry_active and not is_retry_active:
    frappe.enqueue(
        "crm.api.call_log.cancel_retry_log",
        lead_name=doc.name,
        permanent=True,
    )
elif lead_status_changed and new_lead_status == "Archived":
    frappe.enqueue(
        "crm.api.call_log.cancel_retry_log",
        lead_name=doc.name,
        permanent=True,
    )
elif lead_status_changed and old_lead_status == "Cold-Unresponsive" and new_lead_status == "Active":
    # Engagement upgrade within retry-active set: contact was made (e.g. agent picked
    # a "Requirement Confirmed" disposition that doesn't change C-stage, or Script 1's
    # Reactivated→Active auto-flip on C-stage advance). Retry is no longer warranted.
    frappe.enqueue(
        "crm.api.call_log.cancel_retry_log",
        lead_name=doc.name,
        permanent=True,
    )

if status_changed:
    if new_status == "C1" and doc.email:
        frappe.enqueue(
            "crm.integrations.brevo.api.enroll_in_sequence",
            email=doc.email,
            lead_name=doc.name,
        )

    if new_status == "C2-Q":
        if not frappe.db.exists("CRM Quote Request", {"lead": doc.name, "status": "Pending"}):
            qr = frappe.new_doc("CRM Quote Request")
            qr.update({"lead": doc.name, "status": "Pending"})
            qr.flags.ignore_mandatory = True
            qr.insert(ignore_permissions=True)
            try:
                frappe.get_doc({
                    "doctype": "Comment",
                    "comment_type": "Comment",
                    "reference_doctype": "CRM Lead",
                    "reference_name": doc.name,
                    "content": f"[AUTOMATION] Quote Request initiated for lead {doc.lead_name or doc.name}.",
                }).insert(ignore_permissions=True)
            except Exception:
                pass

        if not frappe.db.exists("CRM Task", {
            "reference_doctype": "CRM Lead",
            "reference_docname": doc.name,
            "task_type": "upload_quote",
            "status": ["in", ["Todo", "In Progress"]],
        }):
            frappe.get_doc({
                "doctype": "CRM Task",
                "task_type": "upload_quote",
                "title": f"Upload Quote — {doc.lead_name or doc.name}",
                "status": "Todo",
                "priority": "High",
                "reference_doctype": "CRM Lead",
                "reference_docname": doc.name,
                "description": f"Upload the quotation for lead {doc.lead_name}. Click the Upload Quote button on the task to open the Quote Request, attach the quote file, enter Quote Value and Margin, then set status to Quote Received.",
            }).insert(ignore_permissions=True)

    if new_status == "C7":
        # Pool guard: if no users carry the B2F Team role, the handle_fabricator_lead
        # task will be orphaned. Log to Error Log + drop a Notification Log entry
        # in each Sales Manager's bell so the routing isn't silently lost.
        b2f_user_count = frappe.db.count(
            "Has Role",
            filters={"role": "B2F Team", "parenttype": "User"},
        )
        if not b2f_user_count:
            frappe.log_error(
                message=f"Lead {doc.name} routed to C7 but no users have the B2F Team role. The handle_fabricator_lead task will be orphaned until a B2F user is configured.",
                title="C7 routing: empty B2F pool",
            )
            for sm in frappe.db.get_all(
                "Has Role",
                filters={"role": "Sales Manager", "parenttype": "User"},
                pluck="parent",
            ):
                try:
                    frappe.get_doc({
                        "doctype": "Notification Log",
                        "subject": "C7 routing: empty B2F pool",
                        "email_content": f"Lead {doc.lead_name or doc.name} routed to C7 but no B2F users are configured. The Handle Fabricator Lead task is orphaned until a B2F user is added.",
                        "for_user": sm,
                        "type": "Alert",
                        "document_type": "CRM Lead",
                        "document_name": doc.name,
                    }).insert(ignore_permissions=True)
                except Exception:
                    pass  # bell-notification is best-effort; Error Log is the source of truth

        if not frappe.db.exists("CRM Task", {
            "reference_doctype": "CRM Lead",
            "reference_docname": doc.name,
            "task_type": "handle_fabricator_lead",
            "status": ["in", ["Todo", "In Progress"]],
        }):
            frappe.get_doc({
                "doctype": "CRM Task",
                "task_type": "handle_fabricator_lead",
                "title": f"Handle Fabricator Lead — {doc.lead_name or doc.name}",
                "status": "Todo",
                "priority": "High",
                "reference_doctype": "CRM Lead",
                "reference_docname": doc.name,
                "description": f"Lead {doc.lead_name} has been routed to B2F (C7). Review the fabricator routing reason, coordinate with the partner fabricator, and update the lead to Won (C8) or Lost (C6).",
            }).insert(ignore_permissions=True)

    if new_status == "C8" and not doc.get("custom_external_project_id"):
        # PRD §4.3: Won leads must be mirrored as Projects in the external
        # delivery system. Idempotency is enforced both locally (skip if
        # custom_external_project_id is already set) and at the backend
        # (unique index on external_id=lead.name).
        # No defensive `if doc.email` guard here (cf. the C1 Brevo branch above)
        # — validate_c8_handoff_fields runs in before-save and blocks C8 entirely
        # when email/city/state/pincode/customer_type/lead_type are missing, so
        # the enqueue path can only observe a fully-populated lead.
        frappe.enqueue(
            "crm.integrations.project_api.api.create_project_on_won",
            lead_name=doc.name,
        )

# Reactivation stamp: engagement leaves Cold-Unresponsive (PRD §7). C-stage preserved.
if lead_status_changed and old_lead_status == "Cold-Unresponsive" and new_lead_status in ("Reactivated", "Active") and not doc.custom_reactivated_at:
    frappe.db.set_value("CRM Lead", doc.name, "custom_reactivated_at", frappe.utils.now_datetime())

# Audit comments on engagement transitions.
if lead_status_changed and old_lead_status == "Active" and new_lead_status == "Cold-Unresponsive":
    try:
        frappe.get_doc({
            "doctype": "Comment",
            "comment_type": "Comment",
            "reference_doctype": "CRM Lead",
            "reference_name": doc.name,
            "content": f"[AUTOMATION] Lead moved to Cold-Unresponsive (C-stage preserved at {doc.status}).",
        }).insert(ignore_permissions=True)
    except Exception:
        pass

if lead_status_changed and old_lead_status == "Cold-Unresponsive" and new_lead_status == "Reactivated":
    try:
        frappe.get_doc({
            "doctype": "Comment",
            "comment_type": "Comment",
            "reference_doctype": "CRM Lead",
            "reference_name": doc.name,
            "content": f"[AUTOMATION] Lead reactivated from Cold-Unresponsive (C-stage preserved at {doc.status}).",
        }).insert(ignore_permissions=True)
    except Exception:
        pass

name: CRM Lead — Before Save — Phone Dedup
script:
# Skip during stock-Frappe test fixture loads. test_records.json for CRM Lead
# ships ~35 leads with overlapping mobiles when re-inserted across test-class
# setUp invocations; Frappe's ignore_if_duplicate catches the DB-level conflict
# but server scripts run earlier and would block fixture loading. IndiFrame
# tests in crm/tests/ exercise this dedup explicitly with realistic data.
# Test docs use Frappe's `_T-` naming prefix — a reliable signal inside safe_exec
# (frappe.flags is not exposed in the server-script sandbox).
if doc.name and str(doc.name).startswith("_T-"):
    pass
elif doc.mobile_no:
    # Normalize to E.164 once at the save boundary so admin UI, API, and
    # fixture inserts all dedup against the same canonical form. Website
    # already pre-normalizes (crm/api/website.py:_normalize_phone) so this
    # is idempotent for that path.
    try:
        parsed = frappe.get_attr("crm.utils.parse_phone_number")(doc.mobile_no)
        if parsed and parsed.get("success") and parsed.get("is_valid"):
            doc.mobile_no = parsed["formats"]["E164"]
    except Exception:
        # Normalization failure is non-fatal — fall through to exact-match
        # dedup on the raw value. Caller-side validation handles bad input.
        pass

    existing = frappe.db.get_value(
        "CRM Lead",
        {"mobile_no": doc.mobile_no, "name": ["!=", doc.name]},
        ["name", "lead_name", "status", "lead_status"],
        as_dict=True,
    )
    if existing:
        hint_by_lead_status = {
            "Cold-Unresponsive": "Use the Reactivation flow.",
            "Archived": "Use the Reactivation flow.",
        }
        hint_by_status = {
            "C6": "Lead is marked Lost — investigate before creating a new lead.",
            "C8": "This number is already a customer.",
        }
        hint = hint_by_lead_status.get(existing.lead_status) or hint_by_status.get(existing.status, "")
        message = (
            f"A lead with mobile {doc.mobile_no} already exists: "
            f"{existing.lead_name} ({existing.name}) — Stage: {existing.status} / {existing.lead_status}."
        )
        if hint:
            message += " " + hint
        frappe.throw(_(message), title=_("Duplicate Mobile Number"))
